body:
The sun is a star, just like the stars you see at night. It looks so much bigger and brighter because it is much closer to us.

Earth spins once every 24 hours. That spin makes day and night, and it makes the sun seem to move across the sky. As the sun's position changes, shadows change too.

Earth also travels around the sun once a year. As we move, the night side of Earth faces different parts of space, so we see different stars in different seasons.

And wherever you stand on Earth, gravity pulls you down, toward Earth's center.
title: Our Place in Space
